logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending)
events.content: "Look at you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous)
events.content: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

events.label: CATHERINE (Taunting)
events.content: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Steady)
events.content: "You seem very pleased."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling)
events.content: "I am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister)
events.content: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

events.label: CATHERINE (Scornful)
events.content: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

events.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful)
events.content: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken)
events.content: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

events.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter)
events.content: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

events.label: CATHERINE (Gloating)
events.content: "Do you remember?"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

events.label: CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted)
events.content: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

events.label: CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous)
events.content: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

events.label: JULIANA (Proud, Measured)
events.content: "Gerald chose money."

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute)
events.content: "Clarissa chose a coward."

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
events.content: "I chose myself."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

events.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted)
events.content: "You chose a beggar."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Proud)
events.content: "I chose a man."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

events.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous)
events.content: "A scarred nobody."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified)
events.content: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

events.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking)
events.content: "You call that marriage?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

events.label: JULIANA (Pure, Sincere)
events.content: "I call it love."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh)
events.content: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Piercing)
events.content: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

events.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended)
events.content: "You think love makes you better than me?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
events.content: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

events.label: CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful)
events.content: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful)
events.content: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

events.label: CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive)
events.content: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

events.label: CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist)
events.content: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

events.label: JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative)
events.content: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

events.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding)
events.content: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

events.label: CATHERINE (Enraged Scream)
events.content: "Enough!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

events.label: CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious)
events.content: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping)
events.content: "[gasping] Give it back!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

events.label: CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic)
events.content: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized)
events.content: "No!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

events.label: CATHERINE (Vicious, Final)
events.content: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.
